mapper.sql: select ticket_id, ticket_no, conversation_id, visitor_id, issue_type, question, category, classification_reason, priority, status, preanalysis_summary, preanalysis_solution, suggested_reply, handler_reply, handle_note, handled_by, handle_time, create_time, update_time from ai_customer_service_ticket
mapper.insert: insert into ai_customer_service_ticket ( ticket_no, conversation_id, visitor_id, issue_type, question, category, classification_reason, priority, status, preanalysis_summary, preanalysis_solution, suggested_reply, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{ticketNo}, #{conversationId}, #{visitorId}, #{issueType}, #{question}, #{category}, #{classificationReason}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{preanalysisSummary}, #{preanalysisSolution}, #{suggestedReply}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update ai_customer_service_ticket set priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, handler_reply = #{handlerReply}, handle_note = #{handleNote}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handle_time = #{handleTime}, update_time = sysdate() where ticket_id = #{ticketId}
